sample_unit: patient education guides (5 urological conditions x 2 chatbots)

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education guides (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) versus recommended reading level
links.effect: Guides from both ChatGPT 5.1 and Gemini 3 Pro exceeded the recommended reading level; no statistically significant difference between chatbots on readability, reliability, or similarity.
links.quote: PEGs generated by both AI chatbots exceeded the recommended reading level, demonstrated limited originality, and showed moderate reliability, highlighting the need for professional oversight.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of patient education guides generated by ChatGPT and Gemini across readability, reliability, and plagiarism metrics without evaluating a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
